- ( ) Forget your usual biryani and try this! Aloo Paneer Dum Biryani like you have never tried before :) aap sabki request par, my favourite and Archana ji's family's favourite too! Plus there is a bonus Dry Fruits Raita too!
Preparation time 10 minutes
Cooking time 35-40 minutes
Serve 2-4
Ingredients
For Aloo Marination
1 large Potato (peeled & diced), aalu
300 gms Baby Potatoes (peeled), chhote aalu
